# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser tower-defense game named **Gyatt Grid: Neon Senpai Defense**. Preserve the gameplay truth of a central base defended by orbiting/intercepting units: enemies spawn from outside the field and move toward the center; interceptors shoot projectiles; destroyed enemies award currency; the player spends currency on +Unit, Speed, and Power upgrades; base health reaching zero opens a restartable game-over state. The player can tap the playfield with one thumb to redirect the nearest active defender or target a nearby enemy.

Theme the game as a satirical anime lo-fi neon city session. The base is the Senpai Shrine signal, defenders are chrome chibi friend units, enemies are cringe/rival bots, rewards are clout credits, and the UI uses meme-tone cues like tryhard, gyatt, run it back, and no clout while staying readable. Use procedural CSS/Canvas neon skyline, rain, moon, scanlines, pink/cyan/gold chrome highlights, and mobile-safe HUD buttons.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser-native canvas tower-defense loop: a central base has health, enemies spawn from the outer field and move inward, interceptors orbit and engage, projectiles damage enemies, defeated enemies grant money, and money buys an extra interceptor plus speed and damage upgrades. Failure occurs when base health reaches zero. Input is one-thumb pointer/tap on the playfield to redirect the nearest interceptor or target a nearby enemy.

## Protected mechanics
- Central base health starts at 100 from config and reaches game over at zero.
- Enemies spawn on a timer, approach the center, and damage the base on contact.
- Player starts with funds and one interceptor/tower unit.
- Funds increase from enemy rewards and are spent on the same three upgrade lanes.
- Upgrade costs preserve the prior multipliers: unit x1.5, speed x1.3, power x1.3.
- Tap/click semantics preserve nearest-unit command and target override.

## Remix target
Gyatt Grid: Neon Senpai Defense reframes the same loop as an anime lo-fi neon-city tower defense session. The base is a Senpai Shrine signal, interceptors are chrome chibi friend defenders, enemies are cringe bots, money is clout credits, and upgrades are friend slots, lo-fi boost, and chrome beam power.

## Implementation approach
A single self-contained `index.html` uses Canvas for protected gameplay and CSS/DOM for mobile HUD, authored city atmosphere, start/game-over overlays, and touch-friendly controls. No external engine is used; catalog-backed fonts Orbitron and Rajdhani are used, while audio is synthesized to avoid non-catalog media.
